interpretation: This percentage measures how much of the governed English AURN PM2.5/PM10 registry was represented by the live SOS timeseries route in this release. It is not the completeness percentage for the separate England 30-day AURN network review, which dynamically discovers AURN sites and uses official annual hourly UK-AIR files. A live SOS coverage gap blocks an England-wide current assessment from that route; it does not mean the missing stations are inactive or absent from Defra's other official publication routes.
